verdict.rationale: Edge0 documents a first-party terminal chat command, but describes it as "one-shot chat" with --max-new and --show-thinking flags (edge0-gh-8). It also lists a macOS local CLI (edge0-gh-19). That gives single-prompt chat from the terminal, but nothing shows a persistent, multi-turn interactive session; the serve/curl path is an HTTP API rather than a chat REPL. Missing for 10: a documented interactive multi-turn chat mode (REPL) with conversation history, an explicit invocation example for the chat command, and hands-on corroboration.
